verdict.rationale: Base44 bakes a managed database directly into the builder — the Data page shows every app table as a card for direct editing (base44-docs-9), and the SDK exposes CRUD entity operations against that same backend (base44-docs-23, base44-docs-28) with zero external DB setup. Independent community commentary corroborates this as a deliberate design choice that developers found valuable: 'Maor opted to include the db within the platform, rather than enable persistence externally... made fixing cross-application things very easy' (base44-comm-2). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic schema/table generation from natural-language prompts and independent hands-on proof of zero-config wiring beyond the HN anecdote.
